sapience_notes.note: statix's 'repeated keys' lint in nix flake check's checks.x86_64-linux.statix fires at 3+ occurrences of a top-level `attr."name" = {...};` pattern (e.g. sops's `secrets."x" = {...};`), not at 2. Confirmed empirically: statix check against the 2-entry original modules/system/secrets.nix exits 0; a naive 3rd entry added in the same style exits 1. Fix is the nested `attr = { "a" = ...; "b" = ...; "c" = ...; };` form statix's own error message suggests.

A grep-based 'assert this Nix assignment is quoted' check of the shape `grep -nE 'name *= *[^"]' file` is non-discriminating: the trailing ` *` can match zero spaces, so `[^"]` is satisfied by the single space immediately before the opening quote on an already-correctly-quoted line. Confirmed by running the exact same pattern against a known-good, already-quoted precedent line and getting a false-positive match. A fixed single space (no quantifier) before the character class is required for the check to actually discriminate.

modules/home/services/sapience.nix's built sapience-bootstrap script bakes its stateDir/configFile paths to the real ~/.sapience/* locations at Nix build time (not read from an overridable env var). A scratchpad demonstration of its non-interactive token-reading path must redirect every ~/.sapience reference in the copied script, not just the token path, or the run reads/writes real vendor state (including risking a clobber of the real config.json on an unreachable-host 000 code path, which continues and writes).

users.users.<name>.linger (nullOr boolean) is a working NixOS option on this flake's pinned nixos-26.05 revision (flake.lock rev 643809054d65fdd466a63e3155b8c498cb483c04); confirmed via nix eval resolving true across all 4 host configurations. No systemd.tmpfiles fallback into /var/lib/systemd/linger is needed on this revision.

NixOS's module system safely merges two separate `users.users.<name> = { ... }` declaration sites for the same user across different imported modules (list-typed attrs like extraGroups are unioned; scalar attrs must agree, or the merge fails at eval time) -- confirmed on this flake, where modules/system/users.nix and hosts/usb-installer/default.nix both declare users.users.benjamin with no overlapping scalar conflict.

Decision: Sapience's sourceDirs directory registration (adddir) is deliberately never wired into home-manager activation, because the vendor's adddir CLI requires either a TTY confirmation or an explicit --yes before it reads any file, and an activation context has neither -- an activation-time call would be either a silent no-op that looks like registration, or an unattended, unconfirmed, credential-dependent upload on every switch. This generalizes: any vendor CLI with the same TTY-or-explicit-flag confirmation gate is a poor fit for activation-time automation regardless of how persistent its own ledger/dedup state is.
